skill_origin: corpus-classifier (domain-knowledge-curator mode) + resolve_id/verify_output entity gate + WebFetch investigation
claim_text: ZESTA (CNGB STOmics; Stereo-seq spatial + scRNA zebrafish embryo, 3-24 hpf; Liu et al. Dev Cell 2022) and GSE218068 (GEO; scRNA zebrafish anterior-segment ocular, foxc1b:GFP, 48-144 hpf; PMID 37024546) are open, complementary, and a good fit for the RAG corpus test. The categorization pipeline works end-to-end on real data: corpus_classifier proposed RN1(+RN9/RN8) for ZESTA and RN1(N5 ocular) for GSE218068; the resolve_id entity gate, run on GSE218068's 15404 real gene features, correctly flagged foxc1b/pitx2/prox1a as NOT_FOUND/UNVERIFIED (quarantine, not minted) while pax2a/wt1a/cdh17/gata3 hit the verified store. The test surfaced 3 real findings: (1) the entity gate works on real data; (2) GSE218068 uses RefSeq (NM_*) not Ensembl -> needs a RefSeq<->Ensembl cross-map; (3) the store needs ocular markers. GSE218068 also CLOSES Nat Witt GAP-5 (the 72-120 hpf cornea-dataset blocker). Two corpus records cataloged (pending_review).
human_gate_rationale: The 2 corpus records are pending_review (human gate before commit to the manifest per ADR-0017). Downloading ZESTA (4.8 GB) + curating ocular markers into the verified store are gated next steps.
agent_invocation_status: corpus-classifier (proposer) + deterministic resolve_id/verify_output (Logic-LM-class entity gate). Not an audit gate.
framework_applied: Chain-of-Verification (CoVe) — per reasoning-frameworks-catalog.md §8: the feasibility claim was verified against multiple real evidence streams (GEO + CNGB pages, the downloaded features.tsv with 15404 genes, the resolve_id round-trip) rather than asserted. Per CLAUDE.md §5, framework_applied is self-report.
alternatives_considered: Download the 4.8 GB ZESTA now and vectorize — REJECTED this cycle: bandwidth/compute gated + the RAG backend is still OPEN (nothing to vectorize into yet); metadata-level categorization is the prueba-pequeño test.
Mint ENSDARG for foxc1b from memory to make it 'resolve' — REJECTED (the whole point): the entity gate quarantines it for a real Ensembl lookup + human gate.
Treat the RefSeq vs Ensembl DIFF as an error — REJECTED: it is a namespace difference, not a wrong ID; symbols match.
contradictory_evidence_cited: No actual expression data was read (only the features list + descriptors) — the categorization is metadata-level; data-level QC/analysis is a gated next step.

ZESTA spatial modality is new to the project — no prior spatial ingestion path; RN9 spatial handling is unbuilt.
